methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: A locally-branded AI readiness initiative in the Roanoke Valley signals grassroots capability-building outside traditional tech hubs, though success depends on whether evaluation translates into actual deployment and skill development across the regional economy.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents institutional investment in deep AI literacy for future leaders in a non-metro region, creating potential peer learning networks that could distribute capability beyond NoVA if graduates stay regional.

signals.title: Governor Spanberger signs executive order on data center accountability, creates AI task force - WDBJ7
signals.signal_reading: State-level AI task force creation centralizes AI governance and expertise in Richmond policy circles while data center accountability measures may reinforce infrastructure concentration without addressing capability distribution to underserved regions.

signals.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia — site to be repurposed for mixed-use and residential development. - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Amazon's retreat from NoVA data center expansion due to local backlash reveals infrastructure saturation in the concentrated hub but doesn't redistribute AI capability—it may simply cap growth in an already-dominant region while others remain underserved.

signals.title: Lilly Richmond Groundbreaking: 650 Jobs and a 2028 Talent Push - BioBuzz
signals.signal_reading: Eli Lilly's 650-job biotech facility with 2028 talent pipeline signals deepening specialized capability in Richmond metro's life sciences cluster, but pharmaceutical manufacturing jobs may require different skills than broadly distributable AI fluency.
